meta.name: cloudflare
meta.description: Comprehensive Cloudflare platform skill covering Workers, Pages, storage (KV, D1, R2), AI (Workers AI, Vectorize, Agents SDK), networking (Tunnel, Spectrum), security (WAF, DDoS), and infrastructure-as-code (Terraform, Pulumi). Use for any Cloudflare development task.

copy.tagline: 开发部署 Cloudflare 全平台应用
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果要用 Cloudflare 搞定应用开发与部署。
copy.tagline_en: Develop and deploy apps on the full Cloudflare platform
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you build and ship apps on Cloudflare.

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 会变成 Cloudflare 开发助手：根据你的需求（运行代码、存数据、加 AI、做网络或安全等）推荐对应产品（如 Workers、D1、R2、Tunnel），并加载相应详细文档来协助编写配置和代码。
howto.when: 当你提出任何 Cloudflare 开发任务时触发，例如部署 Workers、配置存储、设置网络或安全防护等。

say.text: 我想在 Cloudflare Workers 上部署一个边缘函数
say.note: Claude 会加载 Workers 参考并给出步骤

say.text: 用 D1 创建一个 SQLite 数据库存用户信息
帮我配置 Cloudflare Tunnel 把本地服务暴露出去
say.note: Claude 会提供 Tunnel 设置方法

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude acts as a Cloudflare development assistant. It suggests the right product (Workers, D1, R2, Tunnel, etc.) based on your needs—running code, storing data, adding AI, networking, or security—and loads the relevant reference docs to help you write configs and code.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you ask any Cloudflare development task, like deploying Workers, setting up storage, or configuring network/security.

say_en.text: I want to deploy an edge function on Cloudflare Workers
say_en.note: Claude loads Workers reference and gives steps

say_en.text: Create a D1 SQLite database to store user info
say_en.note: Claude guides you through D1 usage

say_en.text: Help me set up Cloudflare Tunnel to expose a local service
